dct_description_sm: The data is intended to show the levels of total and methyl mercury, as well as food web structure of the zooplankton and algae populations in the Amundsen Gulf during 2008 winter to summer seasons. This time frame coincides with Arctic sun rise and mercury depletion events, as well as spring melt. It will be correlated to inputs of mercury (Hg) from the atmosphere, ice, and water column at the same time.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Mercury depletion events
dct_title_s: Zooplankton and Algae Mercury Data in Amundsen Gulf, 2008
